conclusions: Normal run explicitly passes diagnostic=false; prepare/readiness gates and the original measured query loop, normalization, source verification, scores and replay remain unchanged. Replacing warmup infrastructure checks with may_search is equivalent on the strict path: only a warmup error changes it to false.
The CLI rejects diagnostics for every backend except mcp-stdio and every profile except smoke before creating an output. The explicit wrapper marks measurement_profile coverage-diagnostic.

A successfully parsed readiness state is saved unchanged. Diagnostic collection adds an infrastructure failure even if it is Ready. Prepare or readiness protocol errors never enable collection; a warmup error disables measured collection. Measurement errors remain individual rows in the shared loop.

Gate evaluation is unchanged. Diagnostics retain nonzero status: ordinary diagnostic completion is invalid_measurement exit 2; the existing cancelled path may return exit 3, also nonzero. No quality/performance certification is implied.

Coverage snapshot accepts only admitted file records, config and work path; no query or gold is passed. It uses a read-only SQLite transaction over the same isolated files table and the unchanged product scanner. It distinguishes observed indexing, scanner policy exclusions and unknown reasons, without overriding readiness or certifying retrieval capability.

Per-path classifications are post-run observations. Indexed means present in the files table, not full retrievable language support. Unexpected indexed paths and unresolved reasons remain explicit. Snapshot failure records unavailable rather than Ready.

All five changed paths are in cc-eval; no codecortex product implementation, Cargo lock, original scorer, normalizer, readiness, gate or replay implementation changes. F product/release eval binaries for holdout remain separately pinned.
campaign_requirements_remaining: Bind D evaluator binary/debug build receipt separately from frozen F product binary. engine_provenance observed evaluator tree/head alone is not F product source binding.
Run and retain every canonical query against the exact common inputs and original gold, including hidden paths; retain previous strict 0-row failures.

Preserve actual Unknown readiness, raw identities, path evidence, nonzero gates, replay and compat/native separate reporting. Do not use diagnostic scores for leaderboard comparison or full-coverage quality/performance certification.
